title: Intensive Intermediate Korean II
description:
Prerequisite: KORA201, KORA203 or equivalent, as determined by the Foreign Language Placement Assessment (FLPA), and permission of ARHU-School of Languages, Literatures, and Cultures department.
Restriction: Registration limited to students accepted into the Summer Language Institute.
Credit only granted for: KORA202 OR KORA204. Designed to further develop Korean language proficiency and cultural knowledge at the intermediate level. Taught in Korean.
